root_cause.detail: The exact raid killed both entry targets and the declared Chainwielder, then retained both exact entry-42362 Drudges as alive, attackable, current-generation pack members. GUID 59 reached a 17.7143 percent health low-water mark. The prior safe-memory remediation cleared the transient remembered-anchor override once live-pack authority reconstructed. The terminal loop began after the main tank and two DPS died: the off-tank, three healers, and remaining DPS were still alive, but the generic critical-role partial-wipe branch selected tactical_retreat_no_combat_res_previous_route_anchor before the live-pack reengagement path. The surviving raid dragged both native Drudges backward instead of completing the exact pack or entering a coherent native full-wipe recovery, so semantic progress stopped before Magmaw.
root_cause.decision_assessment: The retreat choice was incorrect for the observed viable survivor composition. Current-generation declared live-pack authority, native hazard movement, and minimum-distance handling must be evaluated before generic partial-wipe retreat when a living tank and sufficient living support remain. A genuinely nonviable composition must still fail closed into native recovery rather than receiving manufactured state, death, target, teleport, resurrection, or assistance. Magmaw entry 41570 was never reached, so no boss-tactic, gameplay, or 4.4.2 fidelity inference is authorized.
remediation_scope: give an exact current-generation live trash pack precedence over generic partial-wipe retreat when a viable living tank and raid support remain
retain hazard and union-safe 15-yard minimum-distance handling before ordinary pack damage decisions
retain native fail-closed recovery for genuinely nonviable survivor compositions
preserve exact entry and GUID ledger, native pathing, threat, death and transition identity, boss routes, Stonecore behavior, and forbidden-assistance gates
independently review, rebuild, reprovision, and rerun uncapped before accepting Phase 1

acceptance.reason: Magmaw was never engaged and no native boss wipe, reset, per-GUID recovery, or ready-check sequence exists.
acceptance.next_gate: Partial-wipe/live-pack ordering remediation, independent Sol-high review, exact coordinated rebuild, fresh provisioning/full verifier/v4 readback, and uncapped canonical rerun.
